Hill is a translating steady 3D Euler solution in a comoving frame with compact vorticity support and an external uniform flow, not a knot.

E011 STATIC_READY is never DYNAMICS_READY; KnotPlot relaxed family excluded from admissible providers despite E011 cross-provider robustness.
The two 2015 curves are dimensionless parametric seeds, not independent physical providers.

3D GP is compressible; its knot-field evolution is not a solution of 3D incompressible Euler.
Spanning 2-chain solid-angle phase and distance-only modulus initialize the vortex without a nearest-point local-angle ansatz.
A finite-box C2 boundary taper matches periodic faces but injects model-dependent preparation energy; not a relaxed GP equilibrium.
Initial signed plaquette winding is tested; evolving plaquette counts do not certify time-dependent knot topology or reconnection count.
Bulk Bogoliubov and time-dependent tangent BdG controls are independent calculation checks, NOT intrinsic knot eigenfrequency.
A genuine knot frequency requires co-moving relative equilibrium/periodic orbit, symmetry-reduced Floquet, >=4 cycles, and mesh/time/core holdout.

D2A signed total angular motion is a Cartesian tracer angle; it is NOT an independently selected knot eigenfrequency.

Global NLS phase changes are not operational time measurements.
No source reconstructs a volumetric finite-core knotted Euler/NLS dynamic state.
E011 source locator hash does not mean original geometry file byte verification.
Hasimoto mirror conjugation reverses the signed LIA time/circulation coefficient; same-beta direct conjugacy is not a valid symmetry test.
Closed reconstructed filament is not guaranteed by conserved NLS mass/energy.
A and B have different shapes and are not pairwise mirror copies.
Only a double-counting-safe frame-neutral shape observable may qualify as candidate internal mode.
Any change to the frozen 3D campaign bytes invalidates the GP3D_campaign SHA; custom sweeps must be new runs or development diagnostics.
